name: Newtrac Foods & Beverages Limited
summary: Newtrac Foods & Beverages Limited presently conducts no significant business operations. Historically, this entity was deeply involved in the textile sector, performing manufacturing, bleaching, dyeing, printing, and knitting processes for various fabrics. These included high pile fur fabrics, general cloth, and other materials crafted from acrylic, polyester, cotton silk, artificial silk, and wool. Moving forward, the company's strategic intent is to produce texturized yarn, cotton yarn, and other textile goods. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, the firm previously operated under the name Markobenz Ventures Limited, a designation it is scheduled to change to NEWTRAC FOODS & BEVERAGES LIMITED in July 2025.
